# Sageframe marketplace (generated — do not edit)

A custom marketplace of Sageframe Products, each installable as a Claude plugin.

Add it in Claude (Settings → Plugins → Add marketplace), then install a Product:

    /plugin marketplace add sageframe-ai/marketplace
    /plugin install bellwether@sageframe

This repo is GENERATED and pushed from the private `sageframe-mcp` repo by
`npm run publish:marketplace`. Do not edit it by hand.
